name: British Museum
description: national museum in London, United Kingdom
summary: The British Museum is a world-renowned museum in London, home to a vast collection of art and artifacts from around the globe. Its iconic architecture and diverse exhibits, including the Rosetta Stone and the Elgin Marbles, offer a fascinating journey through human history and culture.

name: Tower of London
description: castle in central London, United Kingdom
summary: The Tower of London is a historic castle and museum located on the north bank of the River Thames. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, renowned for its rich history, stunning architecture, and the famous Crown Jewels. Visitors can explore its ancient buildings, learn about its role in British history, and view the iconic Crown Jewels.

name: Royal Observatory
summary: The Royal Observatory in Greenwich, London, is a historic site offering insights into astronomy and navigation. Home to the Prime Meridian Line, it features exhibitions on timekeeping, the history of the telescope, and the work of famous astronomers. The site also includes the Octagon Room and the Meridian Court, providing a blend of scientific and historical interest.
